```{r Load all required packages, message=FALSE}

# load libraries
library(Matrix)

```

```{r Question 1, message=FALSE}

A = matrix(c(2,4,3,3,-2,5), nrow=2, ncol=3,byrow = TRUE)
A

B = matrix(c(1,4,2,1,3,4), nrow=3, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
B

C = matrix(c(1,3,5,6,2,1), nrow=2, ncol=3,byrow = TRUE)
C

D = matrix(c(4,2,2,6), nrow=2, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
D

E = matrix(c(1,-1,2,-1,3,1,2,1,10), nrow=3, ncol=3,byrow = TRUE)
E

X  = matrix(c(1,2,3,1,4,6,5,7), nrow=4, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
X

u = matrix(c(1,3), nrow=1, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
u

v = matrix(c(2,7), nrow=2, ncol=1,byrow = TRUE)
v


qa = A+C
qa
#qb = A+B # non conformable - cannot do
qc = A %*% B
qc
#qd = A %*% C # non conformable - cannot do
qe = u %*% D %*% t(u)
qe
qf = u %*% v
qf
qg = t(A+C)
qg
qh = 3 * C
qh
qi = det(D)
qi
qj = solve(D)
qj
qk = det(E)
qk
ql = solve(E)
ql
qm = u %*% solve(D) %*% t(u)
qm
qn = B %*% A
qn
qo = X %*% t(X) 
qo

```

```{r Question 2, message=FALSE}

A2 = matrix(c(9,2,1,2,4,5,1,5,3), nrow=3, ncol=3,byrow = TRUE)
A2

question2 = det(A2)
question2

```

```{r Question 3, message=FALSE}

B2 = matrix(c(6,8,7,6,8,9,2,3,7,2,5,2,6,3,2,1), nrow=4, ncol=4,byrow = TRUE)
B2

question3 = solve(B2)
question3

```

```{r Question 5, message=FALSE}

A3 = matrix(c(2,3,3,6), nrow=2, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
A3

B3 = matrix(c(1,0,0,1), nrow=2, ncol=2,byrow = TRUE)
B3  

q5a = A3 %*% B3
q5a
q5b = B3 %*% A3
q5b

# We get the same matrix!
# This matrix is called the identity matrix because it acts like a 1 in matrix algebra.
# If you multiply a matrix by an identity matrix, you will get that original matrix. 


```

```{r Question 6, message=FALSE}

S = matrix(c(4,3,1,3,9,1,1,2,1), nrow=3, ncol=3,byrow = TRUE)
S

q6 = det(S)
q6


# The determinant of a covariance matrix like the one we have here is "generalized variance". 
# 



```
